acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins in rhabdoid cells were extracted and digested with LysC/trypsin.

enrichment_method.value: PTMScan® HS Ubiquitin/SUMO Remnant Motif (K-GG) Kit
enrichment_method.evidence: The di-GG peptides were enriched by PTMScan® HS Ubiquitin/SUMO Remnant Motif (K-GG) Kit followed by 18-plex tandem-mass-tag (TMT) labeling.

fractionation_method.evidence: The TMT labeled peptides were pooled with an equal amount of each the pooled samples were desalted and fractionated into 40 fractions for whole proteome analysis and 12 fractions for ubiquitinome analysis under basic pH conditions.

fractionation_method.value: reverse phase columns (20 cm X 75 µm, 1.9 μm C18 resin)
fractionation_method.evidence: Each fraction was further separated on a reverse phase columns (20 cm X 75 µm, 1.9 μm C18 resin) during a 1.5h to 2.5 h gradient and analyzed by Q exactive HF (Thermo Scientific) with one MS scan and up to 20 data-dependent high-resolution MS/MS scans.
